[38;5;231m●[39m The Bash tool is blocking the [38;5;153msleep 600[39m command. The tool prevents long blocking operations to maintain
  responsiveness.

  If you need to wait for something, you can:
  - Use [38;5;153mrun_in_background: true[39m to sleep in the background
  - Use [38;5;153mMonitor[39m with an until-loop to wait for a specific condition
  - Run the sleep as part of a larger command that has a purpose

  What are you trying to accomplish? That would help determine the best approach.
